grid.title: Lista de Materiais
grid.expression: SELECT EST.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, EST.CODVOL, EST.CODLOCAL, LOC.DESCRLOCAL, EST.CODEMP, EST.CONTROLE, CASE WHEN -EST.QTDEST <= POS.SUM_QTDEST THEN -EST.QTDEST ELSE POS.SUM_QTDEST END AS QTDTRANSF FROM TGFCTE EST INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON EST.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = GRU.CODGRUPOPROD INNER JOIN TGFLOC LOC ON EST.CODLOCAL = LOC.CODLOCAL INNER JOIN ( SELECT E.CODPROD, SUM(E.QTDEST) AS SUM_QTDEST FROM TGFCTE E WHERE E.CODEMP = 501 AND E.CODLOCAL = 101 AND E.DTCONTAGEM = :DATE AND E.QTDEST > 0 GROUP BY E.CODPROD ) POS ON POS.CODPROD = EST.CODPROD WHERE EST.DTCONTAGEM = :DATE AND PRO.USOPROD IN ('V','T','M','R','E','P','O') AND EST.QTDEST < 0 AND EST.CODEMP = 1 AND EST.CODLOCAL = 101 AND POS.SUM_QTDEST > 0 ORDER BY PRO.CODPROD
